description.narrative: The aim of this technical assistance is to create awareness of and provide guidance on and implementation of gender inclusive practices in the business operations of our customers and their portfolio companies. We engage Value for Women under a technical assistance framework contract to conduct gender awareness and capacity building workshops, perform gender gap assessments, prepare gender action plans and provide prioritization and implementation support for gender action plans for a set of FMO’s customers.
